note: Wowhead's Fury M+ tips give the same generic advice for every dungeon (Spell Reflection often, interrupt casts with Shockwave and Storm Bolt, Rallying Cry), so boss lines for Fury apply those principles and the damage school from in-game tooltips (Spell Reflection for magic damage, Defensive Stance for physical) to each mechanic.

general.name: General
general.sub: Kit summary · pick a Hero talent above

i: tip
Press Recklessness and Avatar together. Avatar of the Storm instantly grants 2 Thunder Blast charges, and with Capacitance each Thunder Blast during Avatar extends it by 2 seconds
aoe
Using Thunder Clap often turns your single-target rotation straight into AoE. It pulls ahead on big, long-lasting pulls (Wowhead)
cc
With Storm Bolts, Storm Bolt stuns 3 targets (cooldown +10 seconds). Wrecking Throw deals up to 500% extra damage to shields, and Javelineer silences non-player targets for 3 seconds
tip
Wowhead recommends Mountain Thane where there are many targets, like dungeons and Delves, and considers it easier to play than Slayer
tip
Bladestorm (1 min 30 sec) is your second cooldown. You're immune to roots, snares, and crowd control while spinning, and Unhinged fires a Bloodthirst every 2 hits
tip
Every 3 Slayer's Strikes from Slayer's Dominance grant Sudden Death (Imminent Demise). Executioner stacks sit on you, so you keep them when switching targets (Wowhead)
aoe
Odyn's Fury (45 sec) is 12-yard AoE damage plus Enrage. Melts packs of short-lived adds fast
tip
Slightly higher boss damage, but weaker sustained AoE than Mountain Thane (Wowhead)
tip
Recklessness · 1 min 30 sec · +50% Rage generation and +20% crit chance for 12 seconds (duration +50% with Rampaging Berserker). Anger Management reduces it by 1 second per 20 Rage spent
tip
Avatar · 1 min 30 sec · +20% damage dealt for 20 seconds (Mountain Thane build)
tip
Bladestorm · 1 min 30 sec · Attacks nearby enemies for 4 seconds; immune to roots, snares, and crowd control (Slayer build)
aoe
Odyn's Fury · 45 sec · 12-yard AoE damage and bleed, Enrage (Slayer build)
tb

Defensive Stance · 15% less damage taken, 10% less damage dealt. Swap in right before big physical AoE and go back to Berserker Stance when it's over. With Stance Mastery, single hits for 20% or more of your max health are reduced by an extra 15% (Slayer build)
tb
Spell Reflection · 25 sec · 20% less magic damage taken for 5 seconds, reflects the first spell. Use it for every magic AoE (Wowhead)
tb
Impending Victory · 25 sec · Heals 30% max health
tip
Rallying Cry · 3 min · Increases max health of party members within 40 yards for 10 seconds (50% more outside of raids; Battlefield Commander adds 2% more and 3 more seconds)
int
Pummel · 15-second melee interrupt, locks that school for 5 seconds. 10% shorter cooldown with Honed Reflexes; on success, +5% damage to that enemy for 10 seconds
cc

Storm Bolt · 30 sec · 4-second stun at 20 yards. Shockwave · 40 sec · 2-second stun in a 10-yard frontal; Rumbling Earth adds 6 yards of range and cuts 15 seconds off the cooldown when it hits 3+ targets. Bosses are immune to both
pos

Heroic Leap · 45 sec (15 sec shorter with Bounding Stride, 70% movement speed for 3 seconds), Charge · 20 sec (2 charges and 3 sec shorter with Double Time). Get back in right after dodging a mechanic to keep your damage going
disp
Warriors have no ally dispel. Berserker Rage (1 min, 30 sec with Fearless) breaks your own fear, sap, and some incapacitates and removes snares
tip
Battle Shout gives the party 5% attack power. Interpose rushes to an ally and takes 30% of the damage dealt to allies within 3 yards (Slayer build)
tip
No battle res and no external defensives for allies. You have no cheat-death either, so take big hits with Defensive Stance and Spell Reflection ready in advance (Wowhead)
cc
Ascendant week: stop grouped orbs all at once with Shockwave, and scattered orbs with Storm Bolt and Pummel (Wowhead)
prio
Voidbound week: throw Wrecking Throw at the Voidbound Emissary's big shield (Mountain Thane build, Wowhead)
pos
Pulsar week: run to the orbs, but don't drag your own orb far from the party. Regroup fast with Heroic Leap and Charge
tip
Devour week: the snare effect is removed by Berserker Rage (Fearless) (Wowhead). Xal'atath's Guile at +12 and above: each death costs 15 seconds

mountain-thane.title: Mountain Thane key points
items: Line up {Recklessness} and {Avatar} with big add packs and boss burst windows, and use the 2 {Thunder Blast} charges right after pressing them
Interrupt add pack casts with {Shockwave} and {Storm Bolt} (3 targets), and throw {Wrecking Throw} at shielded targets

slayer.title: Slayer key points
items: Line up {Recklessness} with big add packs and boss burst windows, and melt short-lived adds with {Odyn's Fury}
Interrupt add casts with {Pummel}, {Shockwave}, and {Storm Bolt}, and take big hits with {Defensive Stance} ready in advance

Rav'i: [광역 피해] The repeating Carrion Burst during Ssscavenging is Nature damage, so pop Spell Reflection every cooldown
[위치] If a Messy Eater pool is far, Heroic Leap onto it first and Charge back to the shield
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Pummel into the 3 back-to-back Toxic Atrophy interrupts from Toxic Barrage
[제어] During Uncoil, stop Writhes casting Toxic Atrophy and Writhes approaching the Spiteful Hunt target with Shockwave or Storm Bolt
[위치] During Death Rattle, Heroic Leap to break the Vine Grip tethers right away
Zul'jan: [위치] If your assigned beam spot is far, Heroic Leap there before the Ritual of the Fang channel
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for the Fang Empowered Nature damage that builds during Ritual of the Fang
[참고] After clearing Ritual Venom with Boneslicer, a 7-second physical DoT remains, so top off with Impending Victory

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Put Pummel into the rotation for Kezkitt's Light Bolt
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for the 8-second Lightbloom Overgrowth Holy AoE, and add Rallying Cry if missed flowers make the damage heavy
[회피] If Fertile Loam snares you, clear it with Berserker Rage (Fearless) and get out of the pool
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [광역 피해] Rotate Spell Reflection every cooldown for Thorncaller Roar (Nature) and Lightcrazed Frenzy (Holy) after 50%, and use Rallying Cry during the Frenzy phase
[회피] If you're targeted by Bloodthirsty Gaze, have Heroic Leap saved to open distance from the boss
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Pummel into the rotation for Warden's Wrath during Moonkin Form
[광역 피해] After 40%, swap to Defensive Stance and use Rallying Cry for Spirits of the Vale. Grievous Thrash is physical, Lightfall is Holy damage
[참고] The Grievous Thrash bleed only clears at full health, so top off with Impending Victory
Ziekket: [차단] Pummel the Lashers' Lightspore Shot before the revive, and if several group up, stop them together with Shockwave
[우선 처치] Revived Lashers are immune to interrupts and crowd control, so melt them together with Odyn's Fury (Slayer) or Thunder Clap (Mountain Thane)
[광역 피해] Rotate Spell Reflection every cooldown for the stacking Lightbloom's Might Holy DoT and Oozing Xylem

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] Ravenous Bellow is physical damage that ignores armor, so Spell Reflection does nothing; take it in Defensive Stance
[위치] If the Spoiled Supplies mushrooms are far, Heroic Leap to step on them first
[회피] Clear the snare from Bonespike Slam's spike pools with Berserker Rage (Fearless)
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Pummel into the Winter's Shroud rotation for the Fractured Shivercore, and if you miss, stun it with Storm Bolt to stop the cast
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for the Frozen Tempest Frost DoT
[회피] If you're snared when you need to dodge Raging Squall, clear it with Berserker Rage (Fearless)
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] Swap to Defensive Stance before the 3 physical hits of Overwhelming Onslaught. It's physical, so Spell Reflection does nothing
[위치] If you're targeted by Echoing Maul, Heroic Leap to reach the edge within 4 seconds
[광역 피해] During Fury of the War God, reduce the Echoing Fury Nature damage you take while blocking an Echo with Spell Reflection

Kystia Manaheart: [광역 피해] Stack Recklessness and Avatar (Mountain Thane) or Bladestorm (Slayer) into Kystia during the 20-second Destabilized window. Reduce the per-second Chaos damage with Spell Reflection
[차단] Pummel your assigned Mirror Images clone's Felstorm, and stop grouped clones all at once with Shockwave
[해제] You can't remove Corroding Spittle (magic) yourself, so call it out to a party member who can dispel it, and reduce the Fire damage with Spell Reflection while it's on you
Zaen Bladesorrow: [위치] If the barrels are far during Murder in a Row, Heroic Leap to get behind the Forbidden Freight first
[광역 피해] Killing Spree is physical damage that ignores armor, so take it in Defensive Stance, and use Rallying Cry if Fel-Infused Freight is still up
Xathuux the Annihilator: [우선 처치] Break the Axe Toss axes next to the boss so Odyn's Fury (Slayer) or Thunder Clap (Mountain Thane) hits both the boss and the axe
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for Infernal Crush (Fire) and Demonic Rage (Chaos), and add Rallying Cry if an axe is still alive
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Pummel into the Chaos Bolt rotation. If you're the target, go for a reflect with Spell Reflection; even without a reflect it cuts the damage by 20%
[제어] Stop the Wild Imp pack's Felfire Burst all at once with Shockwave. Hitting 3 or more cuts 15 seconds off the cooldown via Rumbling Earth

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Dark Bloom and Umbral Rupture are Shadow damage, so pop Spell Reflection
[회피] If there's no room to dodge the orbs from Void Fissure, Heroic Leap out
Atroxus: [우선 처치] When a Toxic Creeper spawns, melt it right away with Recklessness plus Odyn's Fury (Slayer) or Avatar (Mountain Thane)
[광역 피해] Monstrous Roar is physical, so take it in Defensive Stance, and reduce Toxic Aura Nature damage with Spell Reflection
Charonus: [광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for Cosmic Crash's burst and 20-second Shadow DoT
[위치] If you're targeted by Gravitic Orbs, Heroic Leap close to the Unstable Singularity first, but don't touch it
[회피] Clear the Condensed Mass snare with Berserker Rage (Fearless)

The Golden Serpent: [제어] Stop Animated Gold from Lucre's Call with Shockwave and Storm Bolt so they don't reach the boss. Mountain Thane's Storm Bolt stuns 3 of them
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for the Serpentine Gust Nature AoE
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Pummel into the rotation for the Half-Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge, and if two are stacked, stop them together with Shockwave
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for the Awakening Slam Shadow AoE
[참고] If you're targeted by Drain Fluids, heal above 90% with Impending Victory to clear Desiccation
The Council of Tribes: [차단] Put Pummel into the rotation for Zanazal's Poison Nova
[참고] If you're targeted by Kula's Severing Axe, survive the physical bleed with Defensive Stance and Impending Victory
[위치] If you're late to the Barrel Through soak, Heroic Leap to get within 7 yards of the target
Dazar, The First King: [차단] Put Pummel into the rotation for Reban's Deathly Roar, and if you miss and get feared, break it with Berserker Rage
[광역 피해] Line up Spell Reflection and Rallying Cry with the Gilded Destruction Fire AoE and its 15-second DoT

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] Put Pummel into the rotation for Frigid Shard
[우선 처치] Use Recklessness when breaking the intermission Ice Bulwark, and hit grouped Infused Whelps together with Thunder Clap (Mountain Thane) or Odyn's Fury (Slayer)
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for Chillstorm and Frost Overload Frost damage
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Pummel into the rotation for the Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for the stacking Inferno Fire AoE
[위치] When the Firestorm dies, Heroic Leap out of the 20-yard Burnout range
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [우선 처치] When Kyrakka comes down, Charge or Heroic Leap in right away and start damaging
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for the Interrupting Cloudburst Nature AoE
[위치] If you're targeted by Inferno Spit, Heroic Leap out of the party and drop the pool there

Adderis & Aspix: [광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for the Thunder and Lightning soak and Gust Nature damage
[위치] After Gale Force pushes you, Charge or Heroic Leap straight back to keep your damage going
Merektha: [차단] Put Pummel into the rotation for the Toxic Viper's Poison Spit, and stop the snake packs from A Knot of Snakes together with Shockwave
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for the Serpentstorm Nature AoE
Galvazzt: [위치] Swap to Defensive Stance on your turn to soak the Lightning Spire beam. Galvanized increases physical damage taken by 250%
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for Galvanized and Induction Nature damage
Avatar of Sethraliss: [차단] Put Pummel into the rotation for the Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock
[제어] Stop the Faithless Tormentor packs in phase 2 with Shockwave and Storm Bolt so they don't reach the healer
[위치] If you're on Corrupted Lifeforce soak duty, Heroic Leap to get there within 6 seconds

437134.d:
투신 시전 시 우레 작렬이 2중첩 부여되고 천둥벼락의 재사용 대기시간이 초기화됩니다.

투신이 활성화되지 않은 동안에는 벼락이 10%의 확률로 4초 동안 투신을 활성화시킵니다.

우레 작렬
다음 천둥벼락이 우레 작렬로 변화하여 폭풍충격 피해를 입힙니다.

444767.d: 주 대상에게 공격 시 15%의 확률로 대상의 방어를 압도하고 학살자의 일격을 발동시켜 (전투력의 840.42%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 집행자 중첩을 얻어 12초 동안 마무리 일격의 공격력이 3%만큼 증가합니다. 집행자는 여러 번 중첩됩니다.

444769.d:
학살자의 일격을 3회 사용할 때마다 급살이 부여됩니다.

급살 사용 시 다음 칼날폭풍이 가속화되어 추가로 1회 공격을 가합니다. 최대 3회의 공격을 가합니다. 칼날폭풍의 전체 지속시간은 변경되지 않습니다.

급살이 100%의 확률로 폭풍을 거두는 자를 100%의 효율로 발동시킵니다.

444775.d: 광란이 소용돌이 연마를 통해 3명 이상의 대상에게 적중 시 20%의 확률로 강철의 질풍을 방출하여 주위의 모든 적을 공격해 (전투력의 771.909%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 압도당함 효과를 부여합니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

445584.d: 주 대상에게 공격 시 15%의 확률로 대상의 방어를 압도하고 학살자의 일격을 발동시켜 (전투력의 840.42%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 집행자 중첩을 얻어 12초 동안 마무리 일격의 공격력이 3%만큼 증가합니다. 집행자는 여러 번 중첩됩니다.

1244088.m: 특성 · 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1244088.d: 빠른 속도로 아군 주위의 대상 지점으로 달려가 3미터 내 모든 아군이 받는 피해의 30%를 받습니다. 8초 동안 혹은 이 효과로 [(0.2) * 총 생명력] 이상의 피해를 받을 때까지 지속됩니다.

1265357.d: 소용돌이 연마가 활성화된 동안 광란의 마지막 공격이 지면을 강타하여 대상 주위 8미터 내의 모든 적에게 (전투력의 372.289%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

1269310.d: 무모한 희생 사용 시 광폭화 3중첩이 부여되고 무모한 희생의 지속시간이 50%만큼 증가합니다.

1270717.d: 칼날폭풍 사용 시 전투 몰입 상태가 되어, 칼날폭풍이 끝난 후 8초 동안 가속이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

1270724.d: 투신의 지속시간 동안 우레 작렬이 투신의 지속시간을 2.0초만큼 증가시킵니다.

1271925.d: 광전사의 격노의 재사용 대기시간이 50%만큼 감소하며, 시전 시 모든 이동 속도 저해 효과를 제거합니다.

1271948.d:
투척 능력의 사정거리가 5미터만큼 증가합니다.

용사의 창, 분쇄의 투척, 격파의 투척의 공격력이 20%만큼 증가합니다.

분쇄의 투척과 격파의 투척은 플레이어가 아닌 대상을 3초 동안 침묵 상태로 만듭니다.

1280961.d:
태세가 추가 효과를 부여합니다.

광폭 태세
자동 공격 속도가 3%만큼 증가합니다.

방어 태세
자신의 최대 생명력의 20%를 넘는 피해를 입히는 공격을 받으면, 그 공격으로 받는 피해가 15%만큼 감소합니다.

1299025.d: 소용돌이 사용 시 모든 대상에게 분쇄를 부여해 15초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 190.465%)의 출혈 피해를 입힙니다.
